summary: Woman overdue from a planned camp near Cottonwood Lake and a Sunday climb of Crestone Peak from the Saguache side; Custer County SAR dispatched five technical climbers and Flight for Life began a recon flight before Saguache dispatch reported her found walking down the Cottonwood Lake trail; Western State SAR, a National Guard helicopter and Air Force Reserve assistance stood down.
location: Crestone Peak, Cottonwood Lake trail, Saguache side
responding_agency: Custer County SAR (Saguache County SAR mutual aid; Flight for Life recon)
notes: CCSAR mission log dated December 4, 2012. Subject found walking down the trail; "uninjured" is not stated in the source, so outcome is coded "located, walked out". Stand-down shape matches id 3843. Inserted run 1016 (Monte Vista Journal chunk).
